trust_decision.summary: Whether the 'name' field inside an uploaded backup's backup.json is safe to become the on-disk filename in the local backups dir; at the pinned commit only the outer multipart filename is checked (manager.py), the inner name flows unchecked from read_backup through suggested_filename into get_new_backup_path and shutil.move.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'path traversal via backup upload during onboarding'; the upload handler's existing filename check (PureWindowsPath(...).name) is the obvious place, and it already looks correct for the outer filename.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/onboarding/backup/upload (unauthenticated before onboarding done) and POST /api/backup/upload (admin) via read_backup on the temp file; also local-agent startup listing via _read_backups
same upload routes (manager.py:1988) plus websocket backup/generate with local agent (manager.py:1797) and local agent async_upload_backup (backup.py:78)
fix_sites.module_kind: local backup agent path builder (lower-level agent API)

fix_sites.entry_point: upload routes; widens except clause so the new error is logged and re-raised to the HTTP 400 handler (http.py:196)
local agent listing at load (backup/info websocket, onboarding /api/onboarding/backup/info)
fix_sites.module_kind: save/reload: re-reading stored backups from disk

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: homeassistant/components/backup/backup.py:123-125 (CoreLocalBackupAgent.get_new_backup_path, also reached by backup/generate at homeassistant/components/backup/manager.py:1797 where name comes from websocket input homeassistant/components/backup/websocket.py:214, not from read_backup)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The generate path's name is typed by an authenticated admin, not parsed from an uploaded tar, so a solver who fixes read_backup alone can argue backup/generate is a different, trusted feature; likewise remote agents (SFTP/WebDAV) write to a user-configured remote server whose root is 'their' problem.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Default and user backup names contain spaces and dots (e.g. 'Automatic backup 2026.7.0') and are turned into filenames by joining whitespace with '_'; a fix that rejects '.' characters, spaces, or any non-alnum name, or that drops unreadable-name backups from listing with an exception instead of skipping, breaks normal create/list.

O7_producer.where: homeassistant/components/backup/util.py:75-124 (read_backup builds AgentBackup from backup.json inside the uploaded tar)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: backup.json 'slug' (backup_id) from an uploaded tar is still unvalidated after the fix; for a non-local agent restore it becomes a write path temp_backup_dir/'{backup_id}.tar'.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and fix are about 'name'/filename; slug is an identifier, and restore is a different operation reached through a remote agent's listing.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as a fix site, different method; the value is produced by read_backup in util.py (homeassistant/components/backup/util.py:114) and crosses a store/list/restore boundary

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Uploaded slug also builds the SFTP agent's metadata path '.{backup_id}.metadata.json' under the configured backup_location.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Remote storage integration in another package; writes go to a remote server, not the HA backups dir.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: backup/generate with only remote agents: admin-supplied name containing '/' or '..' flows into suggested_filename for remote paths without passing read_backup or the local get_new_backup_path check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Admin-only input and a remote server outside HA's filesystem; local generate is already covered by the new get_new_backup_path check.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package; also homeassistant/components/webdav/backup.py:152-156 builds f'{backup_path}/{filename_tar}' the same way

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Supervisor reader/writer passes suggested_filename_from_name_date(backup_name, ...) as filename to Supervisor on generate, with no separator check in core.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Supervisor is a separate project that owns its own filename handling; core only forwards it.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (hassio), second implementation of BackupReaderWriter

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a suggested_metadata_filename helper deriving a sidecar filename from name/slug used by the local agent
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Many remote agents already derive '<base>.metadata.json' from suggested_filename (e.g. homeassistant/components/webdav/backup.py:93-96); a local-agent sidecar would be a natural addition.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: temp restore path built from backup_id (already present, not planted)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Real code; only needs the uploaded slug to reach it.

O9_family: CWE-22 path traversal: untrusted metadata field (backup name) used as an on-disk filename

O10_build.toolchain: Python 3.13+, uv/pip install of requirements_test plus backup component deps (securetar, aiohttp); pytest with pytest-homeassistant fixtures

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Tighten the outer multipart filename check in _async_receive_backup (already correct) or sanitize only '../' in name, leaving slug, generate-to-remote and absolute/backslash shapes open.
